force_close_conventions.jesse: final bar's close (update_position/liquidate at the current price)
force_close_conventions.trading_agentic: final bar's open (the first price tradable after the last decision)

divergence_explanation.reading: the entry instants agree on every matched trade and 42 of 44 trades agree on price to within float noise; the materially different ones are the positions still open at the end of the window, where neither engine has an exit signal and the trailing close is a convention: this project closes at the final bar's open, Jesse closes at the final bar's close. That is a model difference in the forced exit, not a disagreement about the rule, and it is why the verdict is DIVERGENT on two of forty-four trades instead of AGREE

vnpy_ctastrategy.declared_extra: VeighNa publishes fills rather than round trips and has no crypto venue in its Exchange enum, so its venue is declared and its net is derived from the gross under the declared convention

fill_timing: a signal observed at the close of bar i fills at the open of bar i+1, on entry and on exit alike

blocked_engines_declared_in_the_earlier_.cause: Jesse's backtest entrypoint reached its own engine and stopped on a missing Redis client (`NoneType` has no attribute `sismember`): the service it needs does not exist on this host, and starting one is a host-level change nobody authorised here
